report_identity.report_title: NVC International Holdings Limited 2025 Annual Report

business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells lamps, luminaries, lighting electronic products and related products, with international non-NVC brand revenue as the largest segment.

segments.name: International NVC brand
segments.business_substance: NVC branded lighting products outside the PRC
segments.source: 2025 annual report, operating segments note, pages 222-224

segments.name: Domestic non-NVC brand
segments.business_substance: Domestic PRC sales of non-NVC branded lighting products
segments.source: 2025 annual report, operating segments note, pages 222-224

segments.name: International non-NVC brand
segments.business_substance: Non-NVC branded lighting products outside the PRC
segments.source: 2025 annual report, operating segments note, pages 222-224

business_overview.revenue_model: Point-in-time sale of lighting products through international and domestic sales channels.
business_notes: Major customer concentration is material: customers A, B and C each contributed more than 10% of revenue.
The group has production plants in Zhejiang, Shanghai, Zhuhai and Vietnam and sales channels across North America, Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and the PRC.

non_recurring_items.item: Gain on fair value changes of financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value gain on listed bonds/government bonds and disposed listed equity securities, not treated as core lighting operating profit.
non_recurring_items.source: 2025 annual report, notes 8 and 29, pages 217 and 265-266

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Foreign exchange gain from multi-currency operations, not treated as sustainable operating cash profit.
Interest from cash and deposits; excluded from operating cash profit when related funds are treated as detachable.

funds_assets.business_substance: Demand deposits and short-term deposits for short-term cash commitments; annual report says cash and short-term deposits are mainly deposited with registered banks in Mainland China, Hong Kong and Singapore.
funds_assets.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position and note 30, pages 190 and 267

funds_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed bonds and government bonds
funds_assets.business_substance: Listed bonds and government bonds issued by a financial institution; current financial assets at FVTPL.

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials, work in progress and finished goods for lighting products.
Customer receivables; credit period ranges from 0 to 120 days.

operating_assets.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position, page 190

operating_assets.item: Deposits paid for acquisition of property, plant and equipment
operating_assets.business_substance: Non-current deposits tied to property, plant and equipment acquisition, not treated as detachable cash.

investment_assets.business_substance: Associate interests, including BLIHP; not treated as readily detachable cash for this analysis.
investment_assets.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position and note 24, pages 190 and 253-257

investment_assets.business_substance: Equity instruments measured at FVTOCI; not included in detachable funds pool due limited detail and small size.
investment_assets.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position, page 190

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Bank loans, including US$12.955m unsecured and US$0.587m secured loans.
Mainly contingent consideration payable, plus derivatives.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables, including US$2.880m under supplier finance arrangement settled in operating cash flows.
Lease liabilities for operating premises; treated through cash profit quality rather than deducted mechanically from detachable cash.

other_liabilities.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position, page 190

years.source: 2025 annual report, income statement and cash flow statement, pages 188 and 195-197
2025 annual report, comparative income statement, cash flow statement and segment capex note, pages 188, 195-197 and 224

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow covered accounting profit and capital expenditure, but 2024 free cash flow after capex was negative and 2025 profit contains fair value gains, interest income and FX gains. Cash profit is therefore discounted materially.

evidence.source: Consolidated statement of profit or loss, 2025 annual report page 188
Consolidated statement of financial position and note 30, 2025 annual report pages 190 and 267
Consolidated statement of cash flows, 2025 annual report pages 195-197

gaps: The full annual report does not split cash and short-term deposits by parent company, Hong Kong/offshore entities, Mainland China subsidiaries and Singapore entities; detachable cash therefore uses a conservative group-level haircut.

The annual report discloses cash flow details for 2025 and 2024 in the current filing, but not full 2023 cash flow line items in the extracted current report; sustainable cash profit uses a discounted 2025/2024 cash-flow-informed view.
Restricted cash is not separately disclosed as a balance sheet line; no positive detachable value is assigned to pledged trade receivables or operating deposits.
